title: SPHERE: Unveiling Spatial Blind Spots in Vision-Language Models Through Hierarchical Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model accuracy on position-related questions framed from allocentric (absolute, viewer-to-object) versus egocentric (relative, object-to-object) perspectives to measure if models comprehend object orientations and reason equally well from both viewpoints.

Shuffling the order of answer options in multiple-choice questions across different random seeds to prevent and evaluate whether models rely on the position of the option rather than true understanding.
